adoption_gates.authorizes: nothing: clearing these gates is diagnostic evidence for considering the parallel arm only. It authorizes no deployment, production default change, release, publication, or relaxation of any existing gate.

lineage.change_from_v5: no execution, case, seed, arm, demand, gate or evidence value changed; only the approved PERF-14 source moved — closure preparation was restored to deterministic serial (the threaded prep was a measured regression) and edge-data parsing was replaced by a result-equivalent streaming parser, so run_scenario.py and the harness fingerprints are the only inputs that differ from v5
lineage.harness_change: load_campaign() retires v5 by name and recognizes only v6; the adoption evaluator and pinned gates are unchanged
lineage.outcome_access: no v1-v5 report file, sidecar or run tree was opened while freezing this contract, and no observed value from any of them was copied into it or used as release evidence. The approved v5 diagnostic conclusion — result-preserving but not adoptable, the closure whole-window parallel arm over the validated-completion ceiling — motivated the PERF-14 source changes verified here; that conclusion is diagnostic evidence only.
lineage.v1_disposition: failed: its run aborted on the first of ten trials with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'run_scenario' — the harness could not import the production phase validator when launched as a script. Immutable failed history.
lineage.v2_disposition: retired_consumed: the identity was executed once on 2026-07-23 and is spent — a campaign identity is single-use and may never be executed again. The execution proceeded without the Sol-recorded exact-key approval entry (exact user message, message date, Sol recorder and date) that the active task is required to carry, so its outcomes are invalid audit history and are not evidence for any gate.
lineage.v3_disposition: retired_spent: executed once under recorded exact-key approval on 2026-07-23. Its single-worker report is diagnostic baseline evidence only and no observed value from it is copied into this contract.
lineage.v4_disposition: retired_spent: executed once under recorded exact-key approval on 2026-07-23; result-preserving but not adoptable, because the closure whole-window parallel arm exceeded the validated-completion ceiling. Diagnostic evidence only; the identity may never run again.
lineage.v5_disposition: retired_spent: its approved one-shot paired identity was executed on 2026-07-23 and is spent — result-preserving but not adoptable, the closure whole-window parallel arm stayed over the validated-completion ceiling. Diagnostic evidence only; the identity may never run again.

measurement_design.equivalence_test: per case and trial, the parallel arm's scenario and trajectory semantic digests must equal the serial arm's; any mismatch is reported and returns non-zero
measurement_design.pairing: each case runs both arms with identical demand, seeds, variants, mode, timeout and fresh-cache state, so the only declared difference between paired rows is the seed-worker count

not_evidence_for: adoption of the parallel arm, a production default change, release, gate promotion, or publication — clearing the adoption gates authorizes none of these
any speed-up beyond the exact paired arms, cases, closure, demand and hardware measured here
worker counts other than the frozen [1, 3], caching, or any other optimization lever
purpose: Final verification of the same paired 1-worker/3-worker baseline and exact road-closure workflow, now on the approved PERF-14 source: closure preparation is deterministic serial again and edge-data parsing is the result-equivalent streaming parser. Diagnostic evidence for CONSIDERING the parallel arm, not authority to adopt it.

terminal_decision_rule.on_non_pass: a miss, hard failure, or invalid/inconclusive run permits no retry and no mechanical v7 of the same approach; planning returns to the honest asynchronous validated-completion path or a materially different architecture.
terminal_decision_rule.on_pass: a later Sol-reviewed, freshly user-approved passing execution of this exact key may advance ONLY to separate release validation; passing the adoption gates still authorizes no production default, API, release, publication, Stage-B, or horizon change.
terminal_decision_rule.role: v6 is the FINAL verification identity for the serial-prep + streaming-parser optimization line. It is not permission to execute or adopt.
